Equipment Description P-204A is an API 610-style horizontal centrifugal pump used to transfer stabilized crude oil from the intermediate storage section to the desalter feed system. The pump is driven by a 75 kW electric motor through a flexible coupling. A standby pump, P-204B, is installed in parallel. 2. 4. Vibration Analysis Vibration measurements indicate an increase at the drive-end bearing. Overall vibration was 5.8 mm/s RMS, above the site alert level of 4.5 mm/s RMS. The spectrum showed a dominant component near 1× running speed with a smaller 2× component. The pattern is consistent with possible coupling misalignment, although bearing condition and foundation stiffness should also be checked. Overall Assessment Condition: ATTENTION REQUIRED. P-204A remains operational, but elevated vibration, drive-end bearing temperature, and mechanical-seal leakage indicate developing maintenance risk. Continued operation should be supported by increased monitoring and a planned intervention.
